scope: Read-only review of the frozen reader candidate and probe against the retained GetStateName static proof, tests, and existing main-menu reader interface. No build or runtime process access was performed.

graph.note: The candidate files are retained evidence outside the indexed source tree, so their exact contents were read directly after the Graft query.

skill_coverage.coverage: Complete prior reads reused; hashes unchanged.

confirmed: The candidate matches the assigned HPP/probe pins; the supplied test translation unit matches its stated pin.

GetStateName evidence maps the receiver's frame pointer at +0x20 and state-node pointer at frame+0x44. The candidate reads those locations, distinguishes no-frame/no-node, checks the node sentinel at +0x38 before looking up its FName, and only identifies a named node after validating its metadata type/owner path.

Class-chain traversal is cycle-detected and capped at 16; object/property traversal uses checked reads, owner and type identities, ArrayDim/element-size checks, duplicate rejection, bounded offsets, and the shared reader budget. Metadata caches are sample-local; the next sample rebuilds identity/owner validation, while the probe compares two samples before reporting.

Function metadata lookup checks the owning class, Function type, exact name/package and uniqueness before reading flags at +0xd0, native token at +0xd4, and target at +0xf0. Target RVA arithmetic is guarded by target>=module and the fixed image executable range [0x1000,0x128df79); the code does not read or invoke the target.

The probe opens the requested process with query-limited-information plus VM-read access, verifies the on-disk original executable hash and loaded module path, and performs two observations. Its live-player output does not serialize raw pointers or FName indices; only fixed schema facts, bounded role/physics/energy values, booleans, and identified state metadata are emitted.

Source-level compatibility with main_menu_sync_reader.hpp is preserved: that reader includes live_player_reader.hpp and consumes LiveIdentity; the candidate retains the same LiveIdentity fields and adds separate snapshot types. No duplicate type or conflicting declaration was found in the inspected interface.

review_attention.finding: The candidate deliberately accepts a node whose Class pointer equals the global Class object: it treats the node itself as owner and accepts it if that class object occurs in the actor's class ancestry. The retained tests explicitly accept Weapon as a named script-state result in this branch. This proves ancestry membership, but does not prove the FFrame node is a State object; GetStateName's native body reads the name layout without enforcing a State type. If the field is meant to report an active UE State, this branch can label a class object (for example Weapon) as a state. Treat it as an untyped node-name observation or require authoritative evidence that Class nodes are valid frame nodes before describing it as an active state.
review_attention.evidence: Candidate script_state branch at reader-candidate/tools/live_player_reader.hpp around lines 297-327; test subcase 'class node must be in this actor ancestry' in tests/live_player_reader_tests.cpp around lines 1065-1100; retained GetStateName body review above.
review_attention.certainty: Concrete semantic ambiguity in the candidate's accepted input/test; whether to reject it depends on the intended meaning of the output field.

review_attention.finding: target_in_original_text is established by the pointer falling within the image's declared executable RVA interval. It does not compare target bytes in process memory to original-file bytes or prove the function is reached by dispatch.
review_attention.evidence: function_dispatch reads +0xf0 and performs range arithmetic only; no target-byte read or invocation occurs.
review_attention.certainty: Confirmed limitation, not a code defect if the field is understood strictly as an RVA-range classification.

limits: This is source/test inspection only; no compilation, probe execution, or live process read was performed.
The GetStateName registration remains candidate-only and its static bytes do not establish current Pawn/InventoryManager/DualWeapon state values.
